text:
Recent work supports evaluating factual support separately from recommendation relevance. [Hallucination Detection in LLM-enriched Product Listings (2024)](https://aclanthology.org/2024.ecnlp-1.4/) addresses unsupported product claims; [Beyond Facts (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.06539) evaluates violations of user-intent constraints. Together, these motivate—but do not establish—a diagnostic taxonomy: specific-interest match, broad association, apparent duplication, and unsupported compatibility assumption. Record relevance and evidence support independently: a shared topic can support broad association without establishing specific intent; similar titles can suggest duplication without proving identical content or editions.

For the twenty training-user exercises, a proposed audit protocol is independent annotation by two annotators using identical interaction histories, titles and descriptions. Require item IDs and exact supporting text for each judgment. Mark compatibility “unknown” when required specifications are missing; mark intent “unknown” when interactions do not establish it. Never infer ownership, purchase necessity, satisfaction, or latent diversity/conformity traits. [COLING 2025 abstention research](https://aclanthology.org/2025.coling-main.627/) finds that even strong models struggle to abstain, supporting explicit insufficient-evidence instructions rather than relying on spontaneous uncertainty.

Report per-label counts, raw agreement, nominal Krippendorff’s alpha, disagreements before adjudication, abstention frequency, and evidence coverage—the fraction of judgments with supporting source spans. Check whether spans actually support claims, beyond citation presence. [2024 annotation-quality guidance](https://aclanthology.org/2024.cl-3.1.pdf) emphasizes documenting annotators, sample size and agreement interpretation. Treat twenty users as an exploratory audit; recommendations from the same user are dependent observations. These diagnostics complement the required macro validation HR@10 and provide no measured agreement or coverage until annotation occurs.
